text.en:
For the purpose of continuing and carrying into effect the campaign for the eradication of
rinderpest and other contagious and infectious cattle diseases in the Philippine Islands, initiated by virtue of
the provisions of Act Numbered Thirty-one hundred and sixty-six, the sum of fifty thousand pesos is hereby
appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to defray the necessary
expenses in connection with the campaign against rinderpest and other contagious and infectious cattle
diseases, and said sum shall be disbursed in the manner and for the purposes provided for in said Act
Numbered Thirty-one hundred and sixty-six: Provided, That any balance of the appropriation hereby made
remaining unexpended at the end of each fiscal year shall not revert to the Insular Treasury, but shall be used
for the. purposes for which said appropriation is made, until". exhausted.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 27, 1925.
